proposed_comments.title: Collapse Unicode spaces around line breaks
proposed_comments.body:
### Collapse Unicode spaces around line breaks

**Severity:** `medium`

The implementation currently trims only ASCII space and tab around line breaks, so input such as `First\u00A0\nSecond` keeps the non-breaking space and then inserts another space. Use Unicode space separators in the horizontal-whitespace class so adjacent Unicode spacing is collapsed to the same single separator the feature promises.

```suggestion
        "[\\p{Zs}\\t]*(?:(?:\\r\\n|[\\n\\r\\u000B\\u000C\\u0085\\u2028\\u2029])[\\p{Zs}\\t]*)+",
```

Please add a matching unit-test row such as `First\u00A0\nSecond` -> `First Second` with this change.

proposed_comments.title: Reset the optional shortcut before parsing settings
Preserve the existing WinRT Constants ABI order
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the existing WinRT Constants ABI order

**Severity:** `high`

Adding `AdvancedPasteSingleLineMessage` in the middle of the existing `Constants` WinRT static interface shifts the ABI slots of every method declared after it. A consumer built against the previous metadata can then dispatch `AdvancedPasteAdditionalActionMessage` and later members to the wrong implementation. Please append the new member at the end of the runtime class (or introduce a versioned interface) and keep the matching declaration/definition order aligned in `Constants.h` and `Constants.cpp`.

proposed_comments.title: Add UI coverage for the popup and direct shortcut routes
proposed_comments.body:
### Add UI coverage for the popup and direct shortcut routes

**Severity:** `medium`

The new action changes both the in-app accelerator route and the native global-hotkey -> IPC -> `SingleLine` route, but the current UI test changes only renumber the existing Markdown/JSON interactions. Add Advanced Paste UI regression coverage that copies multiline text, invokes the popup single-line action, invokes a configured direct shortcut, and verifies the saved Notepad output is a single line; include the small source/expected test files and update the predefined UI-test settings with the direct shortcut.

proposed_comments.title: Cover settings serialization and backward compatibility
proposed_comments.body:
### Cover settings serialization and backward compatibility

**Severity:** `medium`

This PR adds a persisted Advanced Paste setting, so it needs Settings.UI.UnitTests coverage for both old and new payload shapes. Add tests that deserialize an older payload without `paste-as-single-line-hotkey` and verify a non-null unassigned shortcut, then round-trip a configured shortcut and verify it is emitted under `paste-as-single-line-hotkey`.

test_instructions: Open Settings -> Advanced Paste and confirm the module is enabled.
Copy multiline text, open Advanced Paste with Win+Shift+V, choose Paste as single line, and verify the target app receives one line with line breaks replaced by single spaces.
Assign a direct Paste as single line shortcut, copy multiline text, invoke the shortcut without opening the popup, and verify the same one-line output.
Restart PowerToys and verify an older settings payload without paste-as-single-line-hotkey loads with that shortcut unassigned rather than preserving a stale value.
